2. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, venue, AELTC) object_type: organization? AELTC is All England Lawn Tennis Club. So type: organization.

3. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, governing body, AELTC) maybe also LTA as second. Could split into two triplets: governing body AELTC, governing body LTA. object_type: organization.

4. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, inception, 1884) relation "inception" or "date of creation". Use "date of creation". object_type date.

5. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, open era start, 1968) maybe relation "open era start". object_type date.

6. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, number of editions in open era, 47) maybe relation "number of editions". object_type quantity.

8. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, prize money, £2,000,000) qualifiers: point in time 2016. So main relation "prize money" object "£2,000,000" with qualifier point in time 2016. object_type: monetary amount.

9. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, trophy, Venus Rosewater Dish) object_type: trophy.

10. (Wimbledon Ladies' Singles, official website, aeltc2010.wimbledon.org/en_GB/about/history/rolls/ladiesroll.html) object_type: URL.

11. (Dorothea Lambert Chambers, most titles amateur era, 7) relation maybe "most titles (amateur era)". But we need subject as person, relation "most titles (amateur era)". Might be better: (Dorothea Lambert Chambers, number of Wimbledon Ladies' Singles titles (amateur era), 7). But we need object_type: quantity.

Similarly for Helen Wills Moody (amateur era regular) 8 titles. Also Martina Navratilova (open era) 9 titles.

Actually they list "3: Lottie Dod Suzanne Lenglen (challenge round)". Might indicate Lottie Dod and Suzanne Lenglen each have 3 consecutive titles (challenge round). So two triplets: each with 3.

15. (Helen Wills Moody, most consecutive titles amateur era, 4) (regular). object_type quantity.

17. (Garbiñe Muguruza, current champion, Wimbledon Ladies' Singles) maybe relation "current champion". object_type: tournament. Also qualifier "point in time" maybe not needed but could add "point in time" 202? Not given year; we can just have as is.

Could be "ordinal rank" but we can treat as qualifier: {"relation":"ordinal", "object":"1"}? Not defined.
